hooks.name: lore-and-culture-check
hooks.description: When Kiro writes story text, cutscene scripts or puppet data, check them against the lore bible and cultural-respect rules.

action.prompt: You just edited narrative or cultural content. Check it against lore.md: every Javanese term is glossed in English on first use in player-facing text; the ritual is never portrayed as evil; traditional figures are treated with dignity; no real dalang names or recordings; aksara Jawa is decorative and translated. Add a `// LORE-CHECK` comment to any line whose cultural accuracy you are not sure about. Keep all player-facing text in English.
